not_a_historical_preregistration: This replay freezes interpretation before local CSV access, not retrospectively before the original experiments.
phase_mapping: Request phase post-source-change is a wrapper-level instruction; exact evaluator accepts only source_on/source_off. Both baseline fixtures report source_off. Their absent V(control) was replaced with synthetic zero. This label is not a measured disconnect.

settling_method.windows: Both trailing W and 2W must pass after last source_connected transition; require at least 2W since that transition. first=max(last_transition_index, searchsorted(time,last_time-factor*W,side=right)-1). Include sample at/before lower boundary.
settling_method.samples: At least 8 points/window, max adjacent gap <= 1 ms. Strictly increasing finite time; finite columns; binary source_connected.
settling_method.rails: CAP_gap=vin_V-cap_V, current icap_A positive vin -> cap, C=1 uF; VIN2=vin2_V-ground, current ivin2_A positive vin2 -> ground, C=4.7 uF.
settling_method.fit: Unweighted numpy.polyfit(elapsed_time,voltage,1), abs(slope)*actual_window_elapsed <= 1 mV. Independent centered least-squares slope also reported.

energy_accounting.voltage_current_polarity: Passive sign convention as stated above.
energy_accounting.integration: Trapezoidal integration on original full-resolution CSV time points; whole trace and the exact trailing predicate windows.
energy_accounting.scope: Only local CAP and VIN2 element accounting, not total system energy balance or source work.

waveform_comparison.reason: No numerical waveform convergence acceptance threshold was predeclared; only timestep halving was checked.
waveform_comparison.alignment: Linear interpolation without extrapolation on common coarse time grid and union of both native time grids in shared time interval.
waveform_comparison.metrics: Max absolute error, time-weighted RMS error, mean signed error, terminal fine-minus-coarse, pooled peak absolute signal scale, max error / that scale (null if zero).
waveform_comparison.step_evidence: 50 us vs 25 us is packet-reported deck metadata; inspect observed time gaps descriptively, not as independent deck or solver proof.

limits: No new solver, model, provider or native execution.
Current wrapper bytes are distinct from the frozen evaluator; historical wrapper bytes are not sealed.
self_powered_success=false is diagnostic writer hardcoding, not a device verdict.
UIC does not prove every hidden initial energy is zero.
No PMIC/model physical admission, hardware success, Agent gain, total energy attribution, or retroactive restamping.
